verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents ways to automate the Editor (the Editor API and the Editor MCP server). It also documents project-level Checkpoints that snapshot and roll back a whole project. Nothing in the evidence shows the product versioning, reviewing or rolling back the automations themselves, so project snapshots are only an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
